[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)** [LC 380 · Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)](https://leetcode.com/problems/insert-delete-getrandom-o1/){difficulty="Medium"}

A packed array samples uniformly in $O(1)$ but deletes from the middle in $O(n)$; a hash set deletes in $O(1)$ but cannot sample by index. Keep both: the array holds the elements packed into `a[0..n-1]`, and a map `pos[v]` says which slot `v` occupies. A deletion copies the last element into the doomed slot, repairs that one element's `pos` entry, and pops the tail (swap-with-last, @sec-ds-a1).

[Solved in full in @sec-ds-p1-randset.]{.card-link}

:::
